sources.raytheon: https://frank.pocnet.net/sheets/138/5/5725.pdf (Raytheon 5725/6AS6W, 15 Dec 1960), pages 8-11; data/raytheon_5725_p8-11.csv and (p.8 bottom Ib, issue #51) data/raytheon_5725_p8bottom.csv

split_check: issue #55 split. Held out (in no fit): Raytheon p.10 bottom Ic2 vs Ec3 and p.8 bottom Ic2 vs Eb. Fitted since #55: p.11 top Ic2 vs Ec3 (held out #25-#53). raytheon_fit_set / split_check_heldout of every entry below use this split; split_51 has the #25-#53 split (p.10 bottom + p.11 top Ic2 held out)

dual_control.fit: issue #55 (option A of #53): model with KR and XA free; Raytheon p.8-11 except p.10 bottom Ic2 vs Ec3 (so incl. p.11 top Ic2 vs Ec3), plus the p.8 bottom Ib curves (weight 1.0 per point); residual ln((I_model + I0)/(I_data + I0)), I0 = 0.02 mA; KR in [0, 0.95], XA in [0.2, 1.5]

refit_51.fit: issue #51 (dual_control until #55, BEFORE of #55): KR = 0, XA = 1; Raytheon p.8-11 except p.10 bottom and p.11 top Ic2 vs Ec3, plus the p.8 bottom Ib curves; same residual

refit_25.fit: issue #25: Raytheon p.8-11 except p.10 bottom and p.11 top Ic2 vs Ec3 (no p.8 bottom); same residual

sensitivity_p8_weight_0_25.fit: as refit_51 (#51), but weight 0.25 per p.8 bottom point

before.fit: GE p.3 + p.4 (Ec2 = 120 V); residual (model - data)/max(data, 0.3 mA)

ablation_raytheon_relative_residual.fit: same Raytheon data as refit_25, BEFORE's residual (model - data)/max(data, 0.3 mA)

raytheon_internal_consistency.point: Ib at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -2 V, Ec3 = 0
Ib at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -4 V, Ec3 = 0
Ic2 at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -2 V, Ec3 = 0
Ic2 at Eb = Ec2 = 120 V, Ec1 = -4 V, Ec3 = 0

koren.note: GE p.3 baseline only; g3 is not an input, so it cannot represent any suppressor data
